\textbf{(b)} The plane misses $L$ when $L$ is parallel to it (and not in it): $\langle a,6,-7\rangle\cdot\langle2,1,3\rangle=2a-15=0\Rightarrow\boxed{a=\tfrac{15}{2}}$. (The point $(1,2,3)$ gives $7.5+12-21=-1.5\ne2$, so $L$ is not in the plane.)

$f_x=y^2-1$, $f_y=2xy+1$. $y=1\Rightarrow x=-\frac12$; $y=-1\Rightarrow x=\frac12$. $f_{xx}=0$, $f_{yy}=2x$, $f_{xy}=2y$, so $D=-4y^2=-4<0$ at both:
\[\boxed{\big(-\tfrac12,1\big)\ \text{and}\ \big(\tfrac12,-1\big)\ \text{are saddle points}}.\]

$\kappa=\dfrac{6|x|}{(1+9x^4)^{3/2}}$. For $x>0$, the numerator of $\kappa'$ is proportional to $6(1+9x^4)-6x\cdot\frac32\cdot36x^3=6-270x^4$, zero at $x^4=\frac1{45}$ (by symmetry also $x<0$):
\[\boxed{\big(\pm45^{-1/4},\ \pm45^{-3/4}\big)}\approx(\pm0.386,\ \pm0.058).\]
